# Both source kinds use the shared inliner, including its late method wrappers.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/inline_batches.go go/main.go
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/inline_batches.go lgo/main.lgo

cd go
go run -O=1 .
go run -O=3 .
logos run -O=3 .

cd ../lgo
logos run -O=1 .
logos run -O=3 .

-- go/go.mod --
module example.com/inlinebatches/go

go 1.27
-- lgo/go.mod --
module example.com/inlinebatches/lgo

go 1.27
-- lgo/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = false
target_cpu = "baseline"
